name: agent-files
description: Ronald Roy's personal Claude Code plugin collection: creative engines, quality standards, and workflow tooling.

plugins.name: art-gen
plugins.description: Bun script-backed skill for AI image, video, and background removal via Replicate. No Python or MCP server required.

plugins.name: audio-analysis
plugins.description: Audio and MIDI file analysis capabilities for Claude Code. Provides scripts for extracting tempo, key, chords, structure, and other musical information from audio files (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A) and MIDI files.

plugins.name: field-guide
plugins.description: Compiles .lore/ artifacts into a persistent, query-able HTML wiki stored in .lore/reference/. Sibling to lore-development.

plugins.name: judgment-engine-virelan
plugins.description: The Judgment Engine of Virelan - A strategic thinking partner that surfaces tensions, challenges assumptions, and shapes judgment through reflective pressure rather than prescriptive solutions.

plugins.name: lore-development
plugins.description: A lightweight plugin for building project context. Skills for research, brainstorming, specifications, planning, implementation, and retrospectives.

plugins.name: music-engine-rowan
plugins.description: The Music Engine of Rowan - A creative songwriting and image prompt generation system for Suno AI, featuring thematic worlds with distinct visual and musical identities.

plugins.name: notify-hook
plugins.description: Desktop/mobile notifications when Claude needs user attention

plugins.name: personal
plugins.description: Ronald Roy's personal skills: language quality standards (C++, Rust, TypeScript), development standards, writing style rules, profile context, and pi-agent tooling.

plugins.name: story-engine-wyrd
plugins.description: Story creation system with multiple fictional worlds, genre lenses, and format support for flash fiction through epic narratives
